name: 性能测量审查（Benchmark Checklist）
description_zh: 在报告或依据一个性能数字（前后对比、提速/回退声明、调优）之前，核查限流器、调优、边界、错误、可重复性、相关性以及活儿到底有没有干。
description_en: Vet a perf measurement (limiter, tuning, limits, errors, repeatability, relevance, and whether the work happened) before you report or act on it. Use when you run a benchmark or report a speedup or regression you measured.
